newsitem.title: UK: Oliver Ashworth firm signs pipeline deal.
newsitem.headline: Oliver Ashworth firm signs pipeline deal.

text.p: British water pipeline company Oliver Ashworth Group Plc said its wholly-owned subsidiary Ashworth Frazer had signed a long-term partnership with Biwater Industries.
The deal will cover supply of iron pipeline systems to the UK water industry.
The two-year contract will start in August, 1997 and could be extended for a further three years.
Ashworth Frazer's annual sales of iron pipe and fittings are expected to increase to 13 million stg from three million over the two-year contract period.
